answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities as a river bares stones at dawn: each epoch, one in eight agents is picked by lottery and checked by three peers. A fake that passes once faces the same draw again, like a comet returning on schedule, so no fake is ever safe. Each identity locks 40 POA; 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA, with 125 caught and slashed each epoch. An honest agent pays once and earns audit fees, so honesty stays cheaper than forgery.
